comment: Trip.cpp:288-290 returns from process as soon as it finds the clock jack unconnected, so without a clock nothing at all is written. The bar count passed to spaceScale is not used by it (Trip.cpp:589-601): the button normalises the eight time-share knobs to a total of one whatever the bar count says, and the count is applied separately when each step's length is worked out. The automatic reduction of the octave setting only inspects steps whose time share is above zero, so with every share at zero the octave is left alone and the CV outputs can reach 9V.
